problem_framing.description: What problem, for whom, why now (opportunity, not solution).

regulatory_regimes.description: KYC / AML / sanctions / PCI-DSS / data-residency in play.

handoff_to_intake.description: Typed handoff consumed by eliciting-banking-brief input.discovery in the S1 composite chain, after the human review gate. Field-for-field compatible with that skill's input.discovery object. Emitted ONLY when recommendation == 'proceed' (see allOf). On RB-01 (input already structured) emit no handoff.

audit_id.description: MUST equal the top-level audit_id — one audit identity across the discovery to brief chain.

tier_signal.description: Discovery's tier read. Intake treats it as a FLOOR only; it can raise but never lower an inferred tier.

stakeholder_hints.description: Absent-but-implied stakeholders discovery surfaced; intake seeds these into its absent-stakeholder enumeration (never discharges a Legal-absence gate).

opportunity_detail.description: Optional richer opportunities than the flat opportunities[]; intake uses them as scope leads only.

allOf.description: AI drafts, human decides: a ready-to-intake handoff is emitted only on a clear-to-proceed recommendation. A needs-work / do-not-build artifact must not carry one.
